items.author: twilightlance.bsky.social
items.context: WHY DID I START A NEW STARDEW VALLEY SAVE WITH A EXPANSION MOD AM I INSANE????????? MY FREE TIME IS RUINED
items.text: The 'one more day' pull in Stardew is real, and an expansion mod makes the whole farm feel new again. Enjoy the ruined free time!

items.author: azobsesses.bsky.social
items.context: It has been forfuckingever since I watched, read, or played anything new. My brain hasn’t let me. Tonight I played Stardew Valley for the first time. This is a big deal, okay?
items.text: That's a big deal, welcome to the valley! It's a gentle game to ease back in with: no rush and no wrong way to play.
